nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set to tx.origin in the Colizeum constructor and used for privileged access control.
Address of the Ferrum Launch Protection contract stored in BotProtected; target of low-level calls from the checkBots modifier, distribute and list.
Public address of the Uniswap-like pair computed by pairOf(wrappedBinance, address(this)); used as bot-check argument.
Public mapping(address => uint) of token balances, mutated directly in transferFrom, distribute and list.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of allowances, set in approve and constructor, decremented in transferFrom.
Total token supply, initialized to 1e27 and read in list when allocating owner balance.
routerForPancake, an IUniswapV2Router02 instance used to add liquidity in list().
wrappedBinance address used as the paired asset when deriving the uniPair address.
Modifier that performs an external low-level call to stopTheBots and requires the returned notABot flag; applied to transferFrom.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transferFrom guarded by checkBots; performs unchecked subtractions of allowance and balance before crediting the recipient.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-restricted function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address with attacker-supplied calldata.
Internal pure helper computing the CREATE2 pair address from two tokens and the hardcoded factory/init code hash.
Owner-only function that overwrites balances of an arbitrary address array and emits Transfer events from address(0).
Owner-only payable function that sets balances, adds liquidity through the router with a block.timestamp deadline, and overwrites arbitrary balances.
Colizeum constructor: sets owner = tx.origin, computes uniPair, and grants infinite allowances to the router and to tx.origin.
msg.sender, used for allowance checks in transferFrom/approve and for owner authorization in delegate, distribute and list.
tx.origin, used as owner and as beneficiary of an unlimited allowance, making authorization phishable.
block.timestamp, used to build the addLiquidityETH deadline in list().
delegatecall in delegate(): executes arbitrary external code in the contract's storage context.
Low-level .call(abi.encodeWithSelector(...)) to stopTheBots in checkBots, distribute and list, with only the returned boolean checked.
External call routerForPancake.addLiquidityETH{value: msg.value}(...) with attacker-influenced parameters and a timestamp deadline.
Native unchecked subtractions allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value and balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom (Solidity 0.7 without SafeMath).
Arithmetic expression totalSupply * 6 / 100 in list() computing the owner's share, evaluated without SafeMath.
Constructor argument _botProtection forwarded to BotProtected and stored in stopTheBots.
Parameter _to of transfer(), forwarded as the recipient.
Parameter _value of transfer(), forwarded as the transfer amount.
Parameter _from of transferFrom(), debited account and bot-check argument.
Parameter _to of transferFrom(), credited recipient.
Parameter _value of transferFrom(), amount subtracted and added.
Parameter _spender of approve(), allowance spender.
Parameter _value of approve(), allowance amount.
Parameter a of delegate(), target address of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate(), calldata supplied to the delegatecall.
Parameter tokenA of pairOf(), one side of the pair.
Parameter tokenB of pairOf(), other side of the pair.
Parameter _toAddresses of distribute(), list of accounts whose balances are overwritten.
Parameter amount of distribute(), value written to every listed balance.
Parameter _numList of list(), used as the token amount for liquidity and for balanceOf[address(this)].
Parameter _toAddresses of list(), target accounts for the post-liquidity distribution.
Parameter _amounts of list(), amounts matched against _toAddresses.
Loop counter i in list() used to iterate over _toAddresses.

edges.reason: owner is assigned tx.origin in the constructor, so authorization of privileged functions depends on an untrusted, phishable origin.
The Colizeum constructor reads tx.origin to establish ownership and allowances.
allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] is set to uint(-1), granting unlimited spending rights to the transaction origin.
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
transferFrom uses msg.sender to read and decrement allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes the allowance under the msg.sender key.
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner), restricting the delegatecall to the owner.
distribute is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) before overwriting arbitrary balances.
list is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) before liquidity operations and balance overwrites.
The owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in delegate.
The owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in distribute.
The owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in list.
The checkBots modifier calls the stopTheBots address stored in state.
stopTheBots is the target of the low-level call with selector 0x15274141 in the modifier.
The checkBots modifier wraps the body of transferFrom and executes before any state update.
The external call to stopTheBots happens before balance/allowance updates in transferFrom, allowing a malicious callee to re-enter the guarded function.
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b) with owner-supplied address and calldata.
transferFrom performs native unchecked subtraction on allowance and balance under Solidity 0.7 semantics.
balanceOf is read and written inside transferFrom.
allowance is read and decremented inside transferFrom.
list computes totalSupply * 6 / 100 without SafeMath to set the owner balance.
totalSupply is multiplied and divided in the owner-share computation inside list.
routerForPancake provides the addLiquidityETH entry point invoked by list.
list calls routerForPancake.addLiquidityETH with value msg.value, token amount and liquidity parameters.
list derives the router deadline from block.timestamp, making execution timestamp dependent.
The addLiquidityETH deadline argument is block.timestamp + 600, a miner-influenceable timestamp dependency.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
The address returned by pairOf is stored into uniPair.
The constructor assigns uniPair = pairOf(wrappedBinance, address(this)).
distribute forwards the supplied address array to stopTheBots via a low-level call with selector 0xd5eaf4c3.
list forwards the supplied address array to stopTheBots via a low-level call with selector 0xd5eaf4c3.
distribute performs an external call to stopTheBots before completing the loop that rewrites balances and emits Transfer events.
list writes balanceOf[address(this)], balanceOf[msg.sender] and balanceOf[_toAddresses[i]].
wrappedBinance is passed as tokenA into pairOf in the constructor.
distribute overwrites balanceOf[_toAddresses[i]] for every supplied address.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor argument _botProtection only exists to seed the BotProtected base state during construction; fold it into the constructor node.
_to is a transient transfer recipient only meaningful inside transfer; fold it into the transfer function node.
_value is a transient amount forwarded to transferFrom; fold it into the transfer function node.
_from is a per-call debited account with no standalone state relevance; fold it into transferFrom.
_to is a per-call credited account; fold it into transferFrom.
_value is the per-call amount driving the unchecked subtractions; fold it into the transferFrom node that contains the arithmetic operation.
_spender is a transient allowance key; fold it into approve.
_value is a transient allowance value; fold it into approve.
Target address a directly parameterizes the dangerous delegatecall, so it collapses into that unsafe operation.
Calldata b directly parameterizes the dangerous delegatecall, so it collapses into that unsafe operation.
tokenA is a pure helper parameter used only to order the pair; fold it into pairOf.
tokenB is a pure helper parameter used only to order the pair; fold it into pairOf.
_toAddresses is a per-call address list whose balances are overwritten; fold it into distribute.
amount is the per-call value written to each balance; fold it into distribute.
_numList is the token amount supplied directly to routerForPancake.addLiquidityETH, so it collapses into that external call operation.
_toAddresses is a per-call distribution list used only inside list; fold it into list.
_amounts is a per-call amount array used only inside list; fold it into list.
Loop counter i is purely local iteration state in list; fold it into the list function node.
